title: Backtrace lacks the caller of a function that never returns
summary: The backtrace of an exception raised in a function that never returns lacks the frame of its caller when the call is not in tail position: `Called from Test.check` is missing. Bytecode and `-Oclassic` have it.

expected.text: The backtrace has `Called from Test.check`; prints `result 3 frames`.

cause: Simplify gives the call no return continuation (its result type is bottom) and `middle_end/flambda2/to_cmm` emits it as a tail call.
reference: related: PR #7642 (marks calls that never return in To_cmm, but only where they cannot be tail calls)
